what: SAP sells the software large companies use to run finance, supply chains, purchasing and human resources (ERP). It is moving its customers from licences they install themselves to cloud subscriptions.
customers: Large and mid-sized companies and public bodies worldwide.
money: the fastest-growing and now largest part
moat: Its systems sit at the core of how customers run their business, so switching is slow, costly and risky.
risks: Customers delaying the move to the cloud
opportunities: Revenue grew about 22% last year with a 73% gross margin
Analysts see about 39% upside from current levels
Moving customers from on-premises licences to cloud subscriptions raises revenue per customer
watch: Cloud backlog growth and the pace of customer migration.
